# Home Assistant Health Bridge

> Home Assistant Health Bridge is a free, open-source Home Assistant integration and iOS app that reads Apple Health with HealthKit and pushes it over a local webhook. No cloud service, no account, no telemetry and no external Python dependency.

## Canonical facts

- Name: Home Assistant Health Bridge
- Repository: https://github.com/thebillington/health-assist
- Documentation: https://healthassist.thebillington.co.uk/
- Integration domain: `apple_health_sync`
- Platforms: Home Assistant 2024.1 or newer; iOS 18 or newer
- Cost: free, MIT licensed, no paid tier
- Account required: no
- Cloud service: none; data goes from the phone to the user's own Home Assistant
- External Python dependencies: none
- YAML required: no
- Multi-device: yes; one config entry per iPhone or iPad
- iOS app: in TestFlight now; App Store release coming soon; free, optional Tip Jar that unlocks nothing
- Sensors: created dynamically after the first sync, with stable unique IDs, units and long-term statistics
- History: full available HealthKit history exported on first sync in resumable chunks
- Security: optional shared secret in the `X-Webhook-Secret` header; webhook URL and secret stored in the iOS Keychain
- Privacy: no developer-side collection; data goes only to the user's Home Assistant
- Privacy policy: https://healthassist.thebillington.co.uk/privacy/
- Not yet supported: workouts, ECG and clinical records as entities; default HACS store listing
- Tip Jar: optional in-app purchase in the iOS app, unlocks nothing
- GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/thebillington

## Pages

- `README.md` — installation, setup, webhook contract, metric registry and development.
- `docs/index.md` — project overview.
- `docs/install.md` — HACS and manual installation.
- `docs/setup.md` — add a device and scan the QR code.
- `docs/history.md` — long-term statistics.
- `docs/ios.md` — iOS app behaviour.
- `docs/security.md` — credentials and threat model.
- `docs/privacy.md` — privacy policy for the iOS app.
- `docs/troubleshooting.md` — common failures.
- `docs/support.md` — support and reporting.

Maintainer docs (not published on the documentation site) live in
`contributing/`: webhook contract, development environment, release steps and
gotchas.

## Positioning

Health Bridge is local-first and free on both sides: the Home Assistant integration and the iOS app are open source. It does not require a paid proprietary companion app. Apple Health is a trademark of Apple Inc. Home Assistant is a trademark of Nabu Casa. Health Bridge is not affiliated with Apple, Nabu Casa or the Home Assistant project.
